coverage: OpenStreetMap outing destinations within Portland's administrative boundary. Incomplete community-maintained listings; explicitly restricted and lifecycle-tagged inactive sites are excluded. Gardens require visitor/public access tags or a botanical/arboretum classification; community/residential gardens are excluded. Courts include mapped basketball, tennis, pickleball, volleyball, badminton and netball pitches, not all sports fields. Unnamed playgrounds, splash pads, courts, skateparks and artwork have descriptive OSM identity labels, not invented venue names. Nearby same-name node/footprint representations in each category are combined when addresses do not conflict; separate assets remain distinct. Equivalent existing parks/gardens/artwork are preferred in discovery when their categories are enabled; direct source links remain available. Approximate points, not verified public entrances. Access, opening hours, admission, reservations, accessibility and seasonal water operation are not verified.
